summary: Iteration 8 — Admin Delete User feature tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 4/5 PASS (1 fail = real backend bug: admin self-delete returns 403 instead of spec'd 400 because is_admin check runs before self-check). Frontend Playwright flow verified: admin UI login → /admin/users Approved tab → delete-user-{uid} button visible on customer row only (admin row correctly omitted) → confirm-delete-card shows with rider name/phone + warning list → Cancel keeps user in list → Yes, Delete removes the row, modal closes, and GET /api/admin/users no longer returns the user.

minor.issue: Spec says admin deleting their own id → 400 'You cannot delete your own account', but implementation returns 403 'Cannot delete an admin account' because the is_admin check (line 862) runs before the self-check (line 864). Reorder the two checks (self-check first) to match spec.

action_items: Reorder checks in admin_delete_user (server.py L851-865): move `if uid == admin.get('id')` (400) BEFORE `if target.get('is_admin')` (403) so admin self-delete returns 400 as spec'd. This is the only assertion failure in the new pytest suite.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_delete_user cascade is comprehensive and correct: releases vehicle, cancels active bookings (kept for audit with admin_notes='User account deleted by admin'), hard-deletes payments/deposits/documents/locations/notifications, broadcasts admin notification. Response shape matches spec exactly.
Frontend admin/users.tsx correctly filters users.filter(u => !u.is_admin) before rendering, so admin rows are never deletable in UI (verified — no [data-testid=delete-user-{admin_uid}] in DOM).

success_rate.backend: 80% (4/5 pytest cases — 1 spec-violation as detailed above)

seed_data_creation: Each test class creates its own fresh customer via /api/auth/request-otp + verify-otp + admin approve. The cascade test additionally creates a TEST vehicle (security_deposit=500), a paid ₹500 deposit, an assignment + paid weekly payment, then deletes everything. Other-admin test inserts a fake admin row directly into mongo and removes it in finally. Frontend run creates and deletes its customer in the same session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend cascade is sound. Frontend testIDs delete-user-{uid}, confirm-delete-card, cancel-delete-user, confirm-delete-user all wired. Only outstanding work: the 1-line reorder of self-check vs is_admin-check in /app/backend/server.py admin_delete_user.
rca_of_issue: Single backend deviation: in /app/backend/server.py:851-865, the order of guard clauses checks is_admin BEFORE the self-id comparison. Because the admin's own row has is_admin=True, the self-delete path is shadowed by the 403 branch and never reaches the 400 branch. Fix: swap the two `if` blocks so the `uid == admin['id']` check (400) executes first.
